<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision (2026-08-08). Regenerates the main time-deposit DiD
table (baseline cols 1-4 identical to tbl_did_time_deposits_20260612 from
main_results_20260806.qmd §0) and adds cols 5-6: total uninsured deposits /
assets (all uninsured balances, incl. transaction and operating accounts),
mirroring the deposit-quantity object in Huberdeau-Reid-Pennacchi (JFI 2025).
Expected null: balances outside the time-deposit category carry no scheduled
rollover decision.
Inputs: panel_smallbank (post-jmcb 20260612 vintage via fallback).
Output: tbl_did_time_deposits (latex/tables, stamped today).
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_tables <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]

setFixest_fml(
  ..reg_dummy = ~ post * high_cecl_equity,
  ..reg_cont  = ~ post * cecl_equity,
  ..controls  = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

dict_did <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
              "unins_deps_assets" = "Total Unins. Dep./Assets (\\%)")
order_did_tbl <- c("Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL")

r <- list(
  feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(ins_time_deps_assets   ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(ins_time_deps_assets   ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_deps_assets      ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_deps_assets      ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)

cat("\n================ TIME-DEPOSIT DID + TOTAL UNINSURED ================\n")
etable(r, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r, "tbl_did_time_deposits", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dt_w), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt_w$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("Replication gate: cols 1-4 must equal tbl_did_time_deposits_20260612",
    "(-0.0724 / -0.3935 / 0.0699 / 0.7117).\n")
```
